## Problem and change

Explain the concrete problem, the resulting behavior, and any compatibility impact.

## Validation

List the checks you ran, their results, and any device or integration checks still needed.

- [ ] Relevant source, workflow, or image checks passed.
- [ ] Affected English and Chinese documentation is updated.
- [ ] The diff and attachments contain no credentials, private domains, device addresses, runtime data, or internal audit material.

Report security vulnerabilities privately using SECURITY.md.
